  refine h.transport rfl (fun r hr => S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q hq => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hq; exact hq.1) (hu1 r hr))
    fun r i z pr _ hur hz za zo hpr hzh _ => ⟨z, ?_, za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hu := hu1 r hur
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder := fun hh => by
    have := hu.dead_false
    simp only [endUseS, hpr, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
    exact this.2 (hzh ▸ hh)
  have hlive : HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder := by
    rw [hzh]; exact hu.owner_live (show (endUseS s p).P[r]? = _ from hpr)
  show (cleanup (endUseS s p)).A[i]? = _
  rw [cleanup_get, endUseS_get, hz]; simp [hnh, hlive]

theorem free_rootLive {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p a : Nat} (h : RootLive s)
    (hs : FreeStep k p a s (.ok s')) : RootLive s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  have hu1 : ∀ r, (freeEff s p).Usable r → (freeS s p).Usable r :=
    fun _ hr => S3.Usable.of_eqs hr rfl rfl rfl
  refine h.transport rfl (fun r hr => S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := freeS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q hq => by simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hq; exact hq.1) (hu1 r hr))
    fun r i z pr hrp hur hz za zo hpr hzh hzf => ⟨z, ?_, za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hu := hu1 r hur
  have hroot : RootPlace s.P p := by
    have h4 := hpre.2.2.2.1
    unfold OwnedRoot OptP at h4
    split at h4
    · rename_i pl hpl'; exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpl', by simp [parentOf, hpl', h4.1]⟩
    · exact h4.elim
  have hrd : ¬ partOf s.P r p := fun hrp' => by
    have := hu.dead_false
    simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
    exact this.2 hrp'
  have hnc : ¬ ∃ l ∈ z.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p := by
    rintro ⟨l, hl, hlp⟩
    by_cases e : r = p
    · subst e; exact hrd ⟨hrp.1, .inl rfl⟩
    · exact rootsDisjoint_always s.P r p hrp hroot e l ((hzf l).1 hl) hlp
  have hlive : HolderLive (freeS s p) z.holder := by
    rw [hzh]; exact hu.owner_live (show (freeS s p).P[r]? = _ from hpr)
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder := fun hh => by
    rw [hzh] at hh hlive
    cases ho : pr.owner with
    | frame f => rw [ho] at hh; exact hh
    | place o =>
      rw [ho] at hh hlive
      have := hlive.dead_false
      simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
      exact this.2 hh
  have hc : ¬ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨ heldIn s.P p z.holder) :=
    fun h' => h'.elim hnc hnh
  show (cleanup (freeS s p)).A[i]? = _
  rw [cleanup_get, freeS_get, hz]; simp only [Option.map_some, hc, ↓reduceIte, hlive]

theorem exit_rootLive {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : RootLive s) (hs : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :
    RootLive s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  unfold ExitPre at hpre
  split at hpre
  · rename_i f F₀ hF
    have e := exitEff_eq hF
    have hP : (exitEff s).P = s.P := by rw [e]
    have hFe : (exitEff s).F = F₀ := by rw [e]
    have hd : (exitEff s).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
    refine h.transport hP (fun r hr => S3.Usable.mono hP (fun g hg => by
        rw [hFe] at hg; rw [hF]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg)
        (fun q hq => by rw [hd] at hq; exact hq) hr)
      fun r i z pr _ hur hz za zo hpr hzh _ => ⟨z, ?_, za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩
    have hu' : ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable r := S3.Usable.of_eqs hur hP hFe hd
    have hlive : HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } z.holder := by
      rw [hzh]; exact hu'.owner_live hpr
    have hsv : Survives s F₀ i := by unfold Survives; rw [hz]; exact ⟨za, hlive⟩
    rw [exit_A_get hF, hz]; unfold exitG; simp [hsv, zo]
  · exact hpre.elim

theorem transfer_rootLive {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)
    (h : RootLive s) : RootLive (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro r hrp hur
  have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := by
    simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ := h r hrp0 (transfer_usable_back hw hsrc hur)
  have hf : ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint (transferEff s src dst).P r := fun l => by
    rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hzf l
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src z.holder
  · have hc' : heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, { z with holder := .place dst }, { pr with owner := .place dst },
      by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'], rfl,
      hf⟩
  · have hc' : ¬ heldIn s.P src pr.owner := hzh ▸ hc
    exact ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hc], za, zo,
      by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; simp [hc'], hzh, hf⟩

    (hw : WF3 s) (h : RootLive s) (hs : EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')) : RootLive s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  intro r hrp hur
  by_cases hr : r < s.P.length
  · have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := ⟨hr, by rw [← enter_parentOf_lt hr]; exact hrp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ := h r hrp0 (enter_usable_back hw hur hr)
    have hni : i ∉ ps := fun hm => by
      have h2 := hpre.2.1 i hm
      simp only [OptP, hz] at h2; exact h2.2.2 zo
    refine ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hz), hz]; simp [hni], za, zo,
      by show (enterP s ls)[r]? = _; rw [enterP_lt hr]; exact hpr, hzh, fun l => ?_⟩
    show _ ↔ l ∈ footprint (enterP s ls) r
    rw [enter_footprint_old hpre hr]; exact hzf l
  · have hrl := hrp.1
    rw [show (enterEff s ps ls).P = enterP s ls from rfl, enterP_len] at hrl
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, r = s.P.length + k := ⟨r - s.P.length, by omega⟩
    have hk : k < ls.length := by omega
    have hn : (ls[k]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
      have := hrp.2
      rw [show (enterEff s ps ls).P = enterP s ls from rfl, enter_parentOf_new hk] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := append_map_get
      (mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A)
      (fun i => (⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i,
        true⟩ : Authority)) (mem_rootIdx hk hn)
    exact ⟨_, _, _, hj, rfl, rfl, enterP_new hk, rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩

theorem alloc_rootLive {k : K} {s s' : S3} {pv ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hw : WF3 s) (h : RootLive s) (hs : AllocStep k pv ow ls s (.ok s')) : RootLive s' := by
  cases hs with
  | ok hsa _ =>
  intro r hrp hur
  by_cases hr : r < s.P.length
  · have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r :=
      ⟨hr, by rw [← shape_parentOf_lt (hd := .place ow) (ls := ls) hr]; exact hrp.2⟩
    obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ := h r hrp0 (alloc_usable_back hw hur hr)
    refine ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [alloc_lt (lt_of_getElem? hz)]; exact hz, za, zo,
      by show (allocP s ow ls)[r]? = _; rw [allocP_lt hr]; exact hpr, hzh, fun l => ?_⟩
    show _ ↔ l ∈ footprint (shapeP s.P (.place ow) ls) r
    rw [shape_footprint_old hsa.2.2.2.2.2.1 hr]; exact hzf l
  · have hrl := hrp.1
    rw [show (allocEff s pv ow ls).P = shapeP s.P (.place ow) ls from rfl, shapeP_len] at hrl
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, r = s.P.length + k := ⟨r - s.P.length, by omega⟩
    have hk : k < ls.length := by omega
    have hn : (ls[k]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
      have := hrp.2
      rw [show (allocEff s pv ow ls).P = shapeP s.P (.place ow) ls from rfl,
        shape_parentOf_new hk] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := append_map_get s.A
      (fun i => (⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s ow ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls (.place ow) i, true⟩ : Authority)) (mem_rootIdx hk hn)
    exact ⟨_, _, _, hj, rfl, rfl, shapeP_new hk, rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩

  have hlen : (statics.map (·.1)).length = statics.length := by simp

/-- F7 (a), cycle on whole nodes. Frame 1: 0 arena value, 1 allocator value, 2 and 3 node

into B. Expected: the second `store` rejected. Obtained in pass 6: accepted. Obtained in pass 7:
rejected by the clause of arrival of G2 alone, every other clause of `StorePre` holding: after the
store, B is covered by 7 only, held by A, and A by 8 only, held by B, so neither 7 nor 8 would be
exercisable and the current frame would lose `Modify` on B. In `fa7`, 7 is exercisable through 8,
held by the frame, which has effective `Modify` on A (B2). Each state is reached from
`S3.init []`; the list of arenas is non-empty from `fa2` on. -/

def fa5 : S3 := deriveEff fa4 6 6 .modify

    Reachable K0 [] fa7 ∧ fa7.arenas ≠ [] ∧ StoreStep 7 5 fa5 (.ok fa6) ∧
      StoreStep 8 6 fa7 .reject ∧ ¬ HasRight (storeEff fa7 8 6) .modify 6 ∧
      (OptP (fa7.A[8]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame fa7.top)
          False ∧

    Reachable K0 [] dl1 ∧ EnterStep [2, 3] [] dl0 (.ok dl1) ∧ CallProtects dl1 := by
  have he : EnterStep [2, 3] [] dl0 (.ok dl1) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.enter (.derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))) he, he, callProtects_of_check (by decide)⟩

/-- An arena passed in `Observe` and a `Modify` parameter derived from a block held by a value of
the caller (G1). From `fa3` (frame 1: arena value 0, storage 4 of root 4 held by 0, block 5 on
the node 5 held by the node value 2), the caller derives 6, `Modify` on the node 5 from the block
5, and 7, `Observe` on the arena value 0, and calls with `[6, 7]` (expected and obtained: `ok`):
the block 5, origin of 6, is held by the place 2, on which no authority of the callee has an
effective mode; 7 is in `Observe`, which G1 does not constrain. `CallProtects` fails in the
callee, on the statement only: `internal` 4, held by the arena value 0, is exercisable at
`Observe` through 7, covers the leaf 5 of the parameter 6 and is an ancestor of 6, not a
descendant; it has no effective mode on 5 while the block 5 is active. -/
def ob0 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff fa3 5 5 .modify) 0 0 .observe
def ob1 : S3 := enterEff ob0 [6, 7] []
theorem call_arena_observe_block_param :
    Reachable K0 [] ob1 ∧ EnterStep [6, 7] [] ob0 (.ok ob1) ∧ ¬ CallProtects ob1 ∧
      effective ob1 4 5 = none ∧
      (ob0.A[6]?).map (fun y => (y.mode, y.origin)) = some (.modify, some 5) ∧
      (ob0.A[5]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧
      (ob0.A[7]?).map (·.mode) = some .observe := by
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] fa3 := by
    have r0 : Reachable K0 [] fa0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
    have r1 : Reachable K0 [] fa1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] fa0 (.ok _) from
      .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
        _ (.ok fa1) from .ok (by decide) trivial)
    have r2 : Reachable K0 [] fa2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 4 4 fa1 (.ok fa2) from
      .ok (by decide))
    exact .issue r2 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 2 fa2 (.ok fa3) from
      .ok (ar := arFa) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have he : EnterStep [6, 7] [] ob0 (.ok ob1) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.enter (.derive (.derive r3 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) he, he,
    not_callProtects (f := 2) (F₀ := [1, 0]) (p := 6) (b := 4) (l := 5) (m := .observe)
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### `store` on a leaf (G2) -/

/-- `store` into the reference field of a structure (G2): frame 1 has the structure 0 with the
fields 1 (`ptr`) and 2 (`length`), and the buffer 3. The frame derives 2, `Modify` on 3, and
stores it into the field 1 (expected and obtained: `ok`): the field 1 alone becomes `Init`. A read
of `length` is then rejected, the field 2 being `Uninit` (expected and obtained: reject); after a
write of `length`, the read is accepted (twin, `ok`). A `store` into the whole structure 0 is
rejected, 0 not being a leaf (expected and obtained: reject); into the field 1, accepted (twin). -/
def sf0 : S3 := deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]) 1 3 .modify
def sf1 : S3 := storeEff sf0 2 1
theorem store_field_length_uninit :
    Reachable K0 [] sf1 ∧ StoreStep 2 1 sf0 (.ok sf1) ∧ sf1.I 1 = .init ∧ sf1.I 2 = .uninit ∧
      Read3Step 0 [2] sf1 .reject ∧
      Read3Step 0 [2] (write3Eff sf1 [2]) (.ok (write3Eff sf1 [2])) ∧
      Write3Step 0 [2] sf1 (.ok (write3Eff sf1 [2])) ∧
      StoreStep 2 0 sf0 .reject := by
  have hs : StoreStep 2 1 sf0 (.ok sf1) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) hs, hs,
    by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    store_nonleaf_rejected (r := 1) (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- `store` into a leaf that already holds an authority (G2): frame 1 has the leaves 0, 1 and 2.
The frame derives 3, `Modify` on 1, and stores it into 0 (`ok`); it derives 4, `Modify` on 2: the
`store` of 4 into 0 is rejected, 0 holding 3 (expected and obtained: reject). After the `release`
of 3, which leaves the anchors of 0 (F4), the same `store` is accepted (twin, `ok`). -/
def so0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def so1 : S3 := deriveEff (storeEff (deriveEff so0 1 1 .modify) 3 0) 2 2 .modify
def so2 : S3 := releaseEff so1 3
theorem store_occupied_leaf :
    Reachable K0 [] so1 ∧ StoreStep 4 0 so1 .reject ∧ ReleaseStep 3 so1 (.ok so2) ∧
      StoreStep 4 0 so2 (.ok (storeEff so2 4 0)) ∧ Reachable K0 [] (storeEff so2 4 0) := by
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] so1 := .derive (.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have hr : ReleaseStep 3 so1 (.ok so2) := .ok (by decide)
  have hs : StoreStep 4 0 so2 (.ok (storeEff so2 4 0)) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨r1, store_occupied_rejected (j := 3) (z := ⟨.modify, some 1, [1], .place 0, true⟩)
    (by decide) rfl rfl, hr, hs, .store (.release r1 hr) hs⟩

/-! ### Progress (F7; G2) -/

/-- A cycle of three authorities on three nodes (F7; G2). Frame 1: 0 arena value, 1 allocator
value, 2, 3 and 4 node values; storage 5 with the nodes 6 (A), 7 (B) and 8 (C), owned by 0, of
root 5; `newArena 5 5`; the blocks 6, 7 and 8 on the nodes are issued to 2, 3 and 4. The frame
derives 9, `Modify` on B from the block 7, stores it into A; 10, `Modify` on C from the block 8,
stores it into B; 11, `Modify` on A from the block 6, and stores it into C: the last `store` is
rejected (expected and obtained), by the clause of arrival of G2: C would be covered by 10 only,
held by B, itself covered by 9 only, held by A, itself covered by 11 only, held by C. -/
def tc0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]
def tc1 : S3 := allocEff (write3Eff tc0 [1]) 1 0
  [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)]
def tc2 : S3 := newArenaEff tc1 5 5
def arTc : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [6, 7, 8], []⟩
def tc3 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff tc2 arTc [6] 2).1 0 (issueEff tc2 arTc [6] 2).2
def arTc' : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [7, 8], [([6], 6)]⟩
def tc4 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff tc3 arTc' [7] 3).1 0 (issueEff tc3 arTc' [7] 3).2
def arTc'' : Arena := ⟨5, 5, [8], [([7], 7), ([6], 6)]⟩
def tc5 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff tc4 arTc'' [8] 4).1 0 (issueEff tc4 arTc'' [8] 4).2
def tc6 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff tc5 7 7 .modify) 9 6
def tc7 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff tc6 8 8 .modify) 10 7
def tc8 : S3 := deriveEff tc7 6 6 .modify
theorem progress_cycle_three_nodes :
    Reachable K0 [] tc8 ∧ StoreStep 9 6 (deriveEff tc5 7 7 .modify) (.ok tc6) ∧
      StoreStep 10 7 (deriveEff tc6 8 8 .modify) (.ok tc7) ∧ StoreStep 11 8 tc8 .reject ∧
      ¬ HasRight (storeEff tc8 11 8) .modify 8 := by
  have r0 : Reachable K0 [] tc0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] tc1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] tc0 (.ok _) from
    .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 1 0
      [(none, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0)] _ (.ok tc1) from
      .ok (by decide) trivial)
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] tc2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 5 5 tc1 (.ok tc2) from
    .ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] tc3 := .issue r2 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [6] 2 tc2 (.ok tc3) from
    .ok (ar := arTc) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] tc4 := .issue r3 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [7] 3 tc3 (.ok tc4) from
    .ok (ar := arTc') (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] tc5 := .issue r4 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [8] 4 tc4 (.ok tc5) from
    .ok (ar := arTc'') (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have s6 : StoreStep 9 6 (deriveEff tc5 7 7 .modify) (.ok tc6) := .ok (by decide)
  have s7 : StoreStep 10 7 (deriveEff tc6 8 8 .modify) (.ok tc7) := .ok (by decide)

def PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop := s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) := by unfold PinPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `pin p` / `unpin p` (A8): the leaves of `p` become pinned or unpinned. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) (b : Bool) : S3 :=
  { s with pin := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then b else s.pin l }

/-- `pin` as a relation (A8). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p true)

/-- Preconditions of `unpin p` (A8): the external use of every leaf of `p` is done
(`ExternalDone`, MM-03.3.8); B3: the right of `pin`, exercisable `Modify` on `p`. -/
def UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, k.ExternalDone l) ∧ HasRight s .modify p

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s p) := by
  unfold UnpinPre; infer_instance

/-- `unpin` as a relation (A8). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s p) (pinEff s p false)

/-- Pinning changes neither authorities nor places: `WF3` and `Inv3base` are preserved (A8). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves {s : S3} {p : Nat} {b : Bool} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) :
    WF3 (pinEff s p b) ∧ Inv3base (pinEff s p b) :=
  ⟨hwf.of_eq rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl, hinv.1, hinv.2.1, fun q hq x hx =>
    hinv.2.2.1 q ((S3.Usable.congr (s := s) (s' := pinEff s p b) rfl rfl rfl).1 hq) x hx,
    i4_always _⟩

/-! ## `endUse` (A6) -/

/-- The value at `p` ends (A6), before releasing authorities whose holder died: the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; the authorities held by `p` or one of its parts are released; the anchors
of `p` and its parts are removed; the places owned by `p` or one of its parts are logically
dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || match s.P[q]? with
      | some pl => decide (heldIn s.P p pl.owner)
      | none => false
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (A6): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died are released.
No storage is released: `freed` is unchanged. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaves that end with the value at `p` (A6): those of `p`, and those of places that stop
being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root of the value at `p` (A6, pass-1 arbitrage 2): an authority without origin covering a
leaf of `p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `a` is released by the end of the value at `p` (A4, A6): it is active, and held
within `p` (released by `endUseS`) or by a holder that is not live after `endUseS` (released by
`cleanup`). Under the possession clause of `WF3`, that holder dies with `p`. -/
def EndUseReleased (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧
    (heldIn s.P p z.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder)) False

instance (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseReleased s p a) := by
  unfold EndUseReleased; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block the end of the value at `p` (A6): if it is an active derived
authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end releases
(MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) ∨ ∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, EndUseReleased s p a) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives the end of the value at `p` (A6): not held within `p`, not the root of
`p`, with a holder that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse p` (A6). Usability of the anchored places is read after the end:
a place that dies with `p` has no usable dependent afterwards. In order: `p` usable;
exercisable `Modify` on `p` (A2);
no active derived authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end
releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), held elsewhere than in `p` and staying live; no
usable place anchored on an authority held by `p`, on its root, or held by a holder that dies;
C5: no ending leaf pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`), whatever `ExternalDone`
says: external obligations end only through `unpin`. The ending leaves include those of the
owned places, which die (A6). C8: `p` itself stays usable, its leaves `Uninit`. -/
def EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=

/-- The place `p` is an owned root (A6, owned place): no parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

/-- Storage at `p` released (A6), before releasing authorities whose holder died: `p` and its
parts are dead, `p` is freed, every authority covering a leaf of `p` or held within `p` is
released, the anchors of `p` and its parts are removed. -/
def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (partOf s.P q p)
    freed := fun q => s.freed q || decide (q = p)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
      { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `free p auth` (A6): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
released. -/
def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)

/-- Leaves whose storage ends with the release of `p` (A6): those of `p`, and those of places
that stop being usable, such as the places owned by `p`. -/
def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `a` is released by the release of `p` (A4, A6): it is active, and covers a leaf of
`p` or is held within `p` (released by `freeS`), or its holder is not live after `freeS`
(released by `cleanup`). Under the possession clause of `WF3`, that holder dies with `p`. -/
def FreeDeact (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨
    heldIn s.P p z.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) z.holder)) False

instance (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Decidable (FreeDeact s p a) := by
  unfold FreeDeact; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block the release of `p` (A6): if it is an active derived authority on
a freed leaf, or descending from an authority that the release releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), it
is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) ∨ ∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, FreeDeact s p a) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives the release of `p` (A6): it covers no leaf of `p`, is not held within
`p`, and its holder stays live. -/
def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (A6), in order: `p` deallocable by the allocator contract
(`Deallocable`) and `auth` a compatible deallocation authority (`FreeCompat`, MM-03.3.8); `p` a
usable owned root (a part is not a unit of storage, and `WF3` gives a part the `dead` flag of its
parent); exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2); no active derived authority on a freed leaf, or
descending from a deactivated authority, held elsewhere and staying live; no usable place
anchored on an authority covering `p`, held within `p`, or whose holder dies; no freed leaf
pinned, statically (`Pinned`) or dynamically, without exception (B6: external obligations end
only through `unpin` under `ExternalDone`). -/

  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (freeS s p).D q,
    FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

import Ern.MM03
open Ern.MM03

/-! Q1: reading « couvre » as effective coverage (MM-03.3.5 `effective`). -/

def CoversHolderEff (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, effective s a l ≠ none
    | .frame _ => False) False

instance (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (CoversHolderEff s a b) := by
  unfold CoversHolderEff OptP
  split
  · rename_i z _
    split <;> infer_instance
  · infer_instance

/-- `NoOrphan` with the effective reading of « couvre ». Everything else verbatim. -/
def NoOrphanEff (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolderEff s) (a₀ :: c)

theorem linked_closed {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {S : Nat → Prop} (hR : ∀ a b, S a → R a b → S b) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), Linked R (a :: l) → S a →
      ∀ x, (a :: l).getLast? = some x → S x
  | [], a, _, ha, x, h => by
    simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact ha
  | b :: l, a, h, ha, x, hx =>
    linked_closed hR l b h.2 (hR a b ha h.1) x (by rw [getLast?_cons_ne (by simp)] at hx; exact hx)

/-- A set `S` containing every active frame-held authority (frame on the stack) and closed under
`CoversHolderEff` refutes `NoOrphanEff` if it misses an active place-held authority. -/
theorem not_noOrphanEff (s : S3) (S : List Nat)
    (h0 : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true →
      match z.holder with
      | .frame f => f ∈ s.F → a ∈ S
      | .place _ => True) True)
    (h1 : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, CoversHolderEff s a b → b ∈ S)
    (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat) (hx : s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true)
    (hh : y.holder = .place q) (hxS : x ∉ S) : ¬ NoOrphanEff s := by
  intro hno
  obtain ⟨a₀, z, f, c, hz, za, zh, hf, -, hlast, hlink⟩ := hno x y q hx ya hh
  have ha0 : a₀ ∈ S := by
    have := h0 a₀ (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    simp only [OptP, hz, za, zh, forall_const] at this
    exact this hf
  refine hxS (linked_closed (S := (· ∈ S)) (fun a b ha hab => ?_) c a₀ hlink ha0 x hlast)
  have hb : b < s.A.length := by
    unfold CoversHolderEff OptP at hab
    split at hab
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · exact hab.elim
  exact h1 a ha b (List.mem_range.2 hb) hab

/-- `hu1` (module, `held_unexercisable_by_transfer`) is reached and satisfies `NoOrphan`, but
violates `NoOrphanEff`: no chain reaches the authority 2. -/
theorem hu1_not_noOrphanEff : Reachable K0 [] hu1 ∧ NoOrphan hu1 ∧ ¬ NoOrphanEff hu1 := by
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, -, -, -, hn⟩ := held_unexercisable_by_transfer
  refine ⟨r, hn, not_noOrphanEff hu1 [0, 1] (by decide) (by decide) 2
    ⟨.modify, some 1, [2], .place 2, true⟩ 2 (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide)⟩

/-- Same for `iu1` (`held_unexercisable_by_issue`). -/
theorem iu1_frame_held : ∀ a ∈ List.range iu1.A.length, OptP (iu1.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true →
      match z.holder with
      | .frame f => f ∈ iu1.F → a ∈ [0, 1, 2, 3]
      | .place _ => True) True := by decide

#eval iu1.A.length
#eval (List.range iu1.A.length).map fun j => (iu1.A[j]?).map fun y => (y.holder, y.footprint, y.origin, y.active)
#eval hu1.F
#eval (List.range hu1.A.length).map fun j => (hu1.A[j]?).map fun y => (y.holder, y.footprint, y.origin, y.active)

#print axioms hu1_not_noOrphanEff

/-! ## Test cases (MM-03.3 §11 and the tasks of passes 2 and 3)

Each verdict is obtained by `decide` on the precondition of the operation concerned. States are
built from `S3.init` by the effects of operations. Classification of each case (kernel,
abstraction with `K` instantiated, out of kernel) is given in the report. -/

/-- Test contracts: `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable` given by lists of
leaves or places, `FreeCompat` by a list of pairs; no declared disjointness; every allocation
satisfiable. -/
def KT (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat)) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ sh), (· ∈ pinned), (· ∈ done), (· ∈ dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ compat, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

section TestContracts
variable (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat))
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable ((KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => instDecidableFalse
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ sh))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).Pinned :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ pinned))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).ExternalDone :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ done))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).Deallocable :=
  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ dealloc))
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable ((KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).FreeCompat p a) :=
  fun p a => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((p, a) ∈ compat))
instance : ∀ p ls s, Decidable ((KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).Satisfiable p ls s) :=
  fun _ _ _ => instDecidableTrue
end TestContracts

import Ern.MM03
open Ern.MM03

/-! Q3: held authorities that no frame can exercise, built by an operation other than
`store`, `transfer`, `issue`. Each completes a cycle of holders whose stores were all accepted
by G2, via a temporary helper authority. -/

/-- No authority is held by the base frame 0: with `F = [1, 0]`, no frame of the stack other
than the top can exercise anything. -/
def NothingAtFrame0 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.holder ≠ .frame 0) True

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NothingAtFrame0 s) := by unfold NothingAtFrame0; infer_instance

/-! ### (A) `release` completes the F7 (a) cycle that `progress_cycle_whole_nodes` rejects at
the second `store`. From `fa7`: derive helper 9, `Modify` on B (6) from 7; `store 8 6` is now
accepted (the helper keeps B reachable); `release 9`. -/
def fh0 : S3 := deriveEff fa7 7 6 .modify
def fh1 : S3 := storeEff fh0 8 6
def fh2 : S3 := releaseEff fh1 9

theorem f7a_cycle_by_release :
    Reachable K0 [] fh2 ∧ StoreStep 8 6 fa7 .reject ∧
      StoreStep 8 6 fh0 (.ok fh1) ∧ ReleaseStep 9 fh1 (.ok fh2) ∧
      fh1.ExercisableAt 7 .modify ∧ fh1.ExercisableAt 8 .modify ∧
      (fh2.A[7]?, fh2.A[8]?) = ((storeEff fa7 8 6).A[7]?, (storeEff fa7 8 6).A[8]?) ∧
      ¬ fh2.ExercisableAt 7 .observe ∧ ¬ fh2.ExercisableAt 8 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight fh2 .observe 5 ∧ ¬ HasRight fh2 .observe 6 ∧
      fh2.F = [1, 0] ∧ NothingAtFrame0 fh2 ∧ NoOrphan fh2 := by
  have r7 : Reachable K0 [] fa7 := progress_cycle_whole_nodes.1
  have d : DeriveStep 7 6 .modify fa7 (.ok fh0) := .ok (by decide)
  have st : StoreStep 8 6 fh0 (.ok fh1) := .ok (by decide)
  have rl : ReleaseStep 9 fh1 (.ok fh2) := .ok (by decide)
  have r : Reachable K0 [] fh2 := .release (.store (.derive r7 d) st) rl
  exact ⟨r, progress_cycle_whole_nodes.2.2.2.1, st, rl, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) r⟩

/-! ### Two local leaves: q1 = 0, q2 = 1, h = 2 (roots 0, 1, 2). d1 = 3, `Modify` on q2, stored
into q1; helper 4, `Modify` on q2 from d1; d2 = 5, `Modify` on q1, stored into q2 (accepted
thanks to the helper). Without the helper, the second store is rejected (G2). -/
def eu0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def eu1 : S3 := deriveEff eu0 1 1 .modify
def eu2 : S3 := storeEff eu1 3 0
def eu3 : S3 := deriveEff eu2 3 1 .modify
def eu4 : S3 := deriveEff eu3 0 0 .modify
def eu5 : S3 := storeEff eu4 5 1

theorem eu5_reachable : Reachable K0 [] eu5 ∧ StoreStep 5 1 eu4 (.ok eu5) ∧
    StoreStep 4 1 (deriveEff eu2 0 0 .modify) .reject ∧
    eu5.ExercisableAt 3 .modify ∧ eu5.ExercisableAt 5 .modify := by
  have st : StoreStep 5 1 eu4 (.ok eu5) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.store (.derive (.derive (.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) st, st,
    .reject (by decide), by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### (B) `release` of the helper. -/
theorem cycle_by_release :
    ReleaseStep 4 eu5 (.ok (releaseEff eu5 4)) ∧ Reachable K0 [] (releaseEff eu5 4) ∧
      ¬ (releaseEff eu5 4).ExercisableAt 3 .observe ∧ ¬ (releaseEff eu5 4).ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight (releaseEff eu5 4) .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight (releaseEff eu5 4) .observe 1 ∧
      NothingAtFrame0 (releaseEff eu5 4) := by
  have rl : ReleaseStep 4 eu5 (.ok (releaseEff eu5 4)) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨rl, .release eu5_reachable.1 rl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### (C) `endUse` of the leaf h that holds the helper (stored there, accepted). -/
def eu6 : S3 := storeEff eu5 4 2
def eu7 : S3 := endUseEff eu6 2

theorem cycle_by_endUse :
    StoreStep 4 2 eu5 (.ok eu6) ∧ EndUseStep K0 2 eu6 (.ok eu7) ∧ Reachable K0 [] eu7 ∧
      eu6.ExercisableAt 3 .modify ∧ eu6.ExercisableAt 5 .modify ∧
      ¬ eu7.ExercisableAt 3 .observe ∧ ¬ eu7.ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight eu7 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight eu7 .observe 1 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 eu7 ∧
      ReleaseStep 3 eu7 .reject ∧ ReleaseStep 5 eu7 .reject ∧
      EndUseStep K0 0 eu7 .reject ∧ EndUseStep K0 1 eu7 .reject := by
  have st : StoreStep 4 2 eu5 (.ok eu6) := .ok (by decide)
  have eu : EndUseStep K0 2 eu6 (.ok eu7) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨st, eu, .endUse (.store eu5_reachable.1 st) eu, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide)⟩

/-! ### (D) `exitFrame`: the callee builds the cycle on the caller's leaves with a helper held
by the callee frame; the exit releases the helper and re-anchors d1, d2 on the caller's roots.
Caller (frame 1): leaves 0, 1 (roots 0, 1); P1 = 2 on 0, P2 = 3 on 1; call with [2, 3] (`dl1`).
Callee (frame 2): d1 = 4 on 1 from P2, stored into 0; helper 5 on 1 from d1; d2 = 6 on 0 from
P1, stored into 1; exit. -/
def ex1 : S3 := dl1
def ex2 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff ex1 3 1 .modify) 4 0
def ex3 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff ex2 4 1 .modify) 2 0 .modify
def ex4 : S3 := storeEff ex3 6 1
def ex5 : S3 := exitEff ex4

theorem cycle_by_exit :
    Reachable K0 [] ex4 ∧ ExitStep K0 ex4 (.ok ex5) ∧ Reachable K0 [] ex5 ∧
      ex4.ExercisableAt 4 .modify ∧ ex4.ExercisableAt 6 .modify ∧
      ex5.F = [1, 0] ∧ ex5.org 4 = some 1 ∧ ex5.org 6 = some 0 ∧
      ¬ ex5.ExercisableAt 4 .observe ∧ ¬ ex5.ExercisableAt 6 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 1 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 ex5 ∧
      NoOrphan ex5 := by
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] ex1 := call_params_distinct_locals.1
  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] ex2 := .store (.derive r1 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] ex3 := .derive (.derive r2 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] ex4 := .store r3 (.ok (by decide))
  have ex : ExitStep K0 ex4 (.ok ex5) := .ok (by decide)
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] ex5 := .exit r4 ex
  exact ⟨r4, ex, r5, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, reachable_no_orphan (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) r5⟩

/-! ### (E) `enterFrame` attempt: passing the helper of `eu5` as a parameter is rejected by G1
(its origin d1 becomes exercisable through the cycle closed by the callee-held helper). -/
theorem enter_helper_rejected : EnterStep [4] [] eu5 .reject := .reject (by decide)
theorem enter_helper_reason : ¬ ParamOriginHidden (enterEff eu5 [4] []) 4 := by decide

#print axioms f7a_cycle_by_release
#print axioms cycle_by_release
#print axioms cycle_by_endUse
#print axioms cycle_by_exit
#print axioms enter_helper_rejected

def eu4 : S3 := deriveEff eu3 0 0 .modify
def eu5 : S3 := storeEff eu4 5 1

theorem eu5_reachable : Reachable K0 [] eu5 ∧ StoreStep 5 1 eu4 (.ok eu5) ∧
    StoreStep 4 1 (deriveEff eu2 0 0 .modify) .reject ∧
    eu5.ExercisableAt 3 .modify ∧ eu5.ExercisableAt 5 .modify := by
  have st : StoreStep 5 1 eu4 (.ok eu5) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.store (.derive (.derive (.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) st, st,
    .reject (by decide), by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### (B) `release` of the helper. -/
theorem cycle_by_release :
    ReleaseStep 4 eu5 (.ok (releaseEff eu5 4)) ∧ Reachable K0 [] (releaseEff eu5 4) ∧
      ¬ (releaseEff eu5 4).ExercisableAt 3 .observe ∧ ¬ (releaseEff eu5 4).ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight (releaseEff eu5 4) .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight (releaseEff eu5 4) .observe 1 ∧
      NothingAtFrame0 (releaseEff eu5 4) := by
  have rl : ReleaseStep 4 eu5 (.ok (releaseEff eu5 4)) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨rl, .release eu5_reachable.1 rl, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

      eu6.ExercisableAt 3 .modify ∧ eu6.ExercisableAt 5 .modify ∧
      ¬ eu7.ExercisableAt 3 .observe ∧ ¬ eu7.ExercisableAt 5 .observe ∧
      ¬ HasRight eu7 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight eu7 .observe 1 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 eu7 ∧
      ReleaseStep 3 eu7 .reject ∧ ReleaseStep 5 eu7 .reject ∧
      EndUseStep K0 0 eu7 .reject ∧ EndUseStep K0 1 eu7 .reject := by
  have st : StoreStep 4 2 eu5 (.ok eu6) := .ok (by decide)
  have eu : EndUseStep K0 2 eu6 (.ok eu7) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨st, eu, .endUse (.store eu5_reachable.1 st) eu, by decide, by decide, by decide,

    .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide)⟩

by the callee frame; the exit releases the helper and re-anchors d1, d2 on the caller's roots.

def ex2 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff ex1 3 1 .modify) 4 0
def ex3 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff ex2 4 1 .modify) 2 0 .modify
def ex4 : S3 := storeEff ex3 6 1
def ex5 : S3 := exitEff ex4

theorem cycle_by_exit :
    Reachable K0 [] ex4 ∧ ExitStep K0 ex4 (.ok ex5) ∧ Reachable K0 [] ex5 ∧
      ex4.ExercisableAt 4 .modify ∧ ex4.ExercisableAt 6 .modify ∧

      ¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 0 ∧ ¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 1 ∧ NothingAtFrame0 ex5 ∧
      NoOrphan ex5 := by

  have r2 : Reachable K0 [] ex2 := .store (.derive r1 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] ex3 := .derive (.derive r2 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have r4 : Reachable K0 [] ex4 := .store r3 (.ok (by decide))
  have ex : ExitStep K0 ex4 (.ok ex5) := .ok (by decide)
  have r5 : Reachable K0 [] ex5 := .exit r4 ex

input.message:
**Verdict: ok on the formalization. Two major spec defects need to go to the arbiter.**

I reviewed HEAD 72337e7. While I worked, someone was changing `formal/Ern/MM03.lean` in the working tree (an `EnterPreBase` split, and `held_unexercisable_by_transfer` gained exit conjuncts), and a `lake build` was running. To stay on HEAD, I put `git show 72337e7:formal/Ern/MM03.lean` in a scratch folder and compiled it there with plain `lean -o` (not `lake build`; it finished without errors). All checks ran against that olean. Every witness below compiles, and each uses only `[propext, Quot.sound]`. A check confirmed that `decide` does reject false claims on these states. Scratch files, all in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/p7rev_g3/`: `Q1.lean`, `Q3.lean`, `Q3free.lean`, `Q4.lean`, plus the compiled HEAD copy in `head/`.

## Findings

**F1. Major, spec defect. G3 as written holds for structural reasons and does not exclude cycles. A plausible stronger reading makes `reachable_no_orphan` false.**
- Location: `NoOrphan` / `CoversHolder` (lines 6045–6063), `noOrphan_of_rootLive` (6310), `store_rootLive` (6392).
- `CoversHolder` reads « couvre » as "every leaf of the holder place is in the link's footprint". That matches how MM‑03.3.5 uses the word: "Si `a` est inactive ou ne couvre pas `p`" keeps covering separate from effectiveness. So the definition is faithful and is not a formalization error.
- Under that reading, NoOrphan follows from `WF3 ∧ RootLive` alone. The chain is just the root authorities along the owner chain. Root authorities stay active even when a descendant suspends them.
- `store_rootLive` uses only the first conjunct of `StorePre` (via `store_pre_auth`: active, derived, frame-held). None of the G2 clauses play a role.
- Consequence: the exact F7 (a) configuration that G2 rejects satisfies NoOrphan (witness `f7a_cycle_by_release` under F2, conjunct `NoOrphan fh2`).
- Other readings:
  - "One leaf" is weaker, so the theorem still holds.
  - "Exercisable links" with footprint coverage still holds on `hu1`: `hu1.ExercisableAt 1 .modify` by `decide`, and the chain is root 1 → 2.
  - "Effective coverage" (each link has `effective ≠ none` on every leaf of the next holder) is false on reached states. `Q1.lean` defines `NoOrphanEff` as `NoOrphan` with `CoversHolderEff` in place of `CoversHolder`, and refutes it with a closed set of authorities:
```lean
theorem hu1_not_noOrphanEff : Reachable K0 [] hu1 ∧ NoOrphan hu1 ∧ ¬ NoOrphanEff hu1
theorem iu1_not_noOrphanEff : Reachable K0 [] iu1 ∧ NoOrphan iu1 ∧ ¬ NoOrphanEff iu1
-- 'hu1_not_noOrphanEff' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
-- 'iu1_not_noOrphanEff' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
```

**F2. Major, spec defect against the arbiter's intent. Release, endUse, free and exit also build held authorities that no frame can exercise, and G2's guard on `store` can be bypassed with a helper.**
- Location: G2 arrival clause in `StorePre` (1263); `progress_cycle_whole_nodes` (10484); the G3 witnesses (10755, 10769) only show `transfer` and `issue`.
- The pattern: keep a temporary helper (a `Modify` authority, held by the frame, on the cycle's target). Each `store` then passes the G2 arrival clause. Removing the helper with an operation other than `store` closes the cycle.
- In every case below, the base frame 0 holds no authority (`NothingAtFrame0`), so no frame of the stack can exercise the cycle. The authorities' holder places are no longer reachable even at `Observe`.
- (A) Release reaches the exact F7 (a) state that pass 7 rejects:
```lean
def fh0 := deriveEff fa7 7 6 .modify; def fh1 := storeEff fh0 8 6; def fh2 := releaseEff fh1 9
theorem f7a_cycle_by_release : Reachable K0 [] fh2 ∧ StoreStep 8 6 fa7 .reject ∧
  StoreStep 8 6 fh0 (.ok fh1) ∧ ReleaseStep 9 fh1 (.ok fh2) ∧
  fh1.ExercisableAt 7 .modify ∧ fh1.ExercisableAt 8 .modify ∧
  (fh2.A[7]?, fh2.A[8]?) = ((storeEff fa7 8 6).A[7]?, (storeEff fa7 8 6).A[8]?) ∧
  ¬ fh2.ExercisableAt 7 .observe ∧ ¬ fh2.ExercisableAt 8 .observe ∧
  ¬ HasRight fh2 .observe 5 ∧ ¬ HasRight fh2 .observe 6 ∧ fh2.F = [1, 0] ∧
  NothingAtFrame0 fh2 ∧ NoOrphan fh2
```
- (B) The same with two local leaves (`eu5`). Without the helper the second store is rejected: `StoreStep 4 1 (deriveEff eu2 0 0 .modify) .reject`. With it the store is accepted; then `release 4` closes the cycle (`cycle_by_release`).
- (C) EndUse: the helper is stored into leaf 2 (`ok`), then `endUse 2` (`ok`) closes the cycle. Afterwards `release 3`, `release 5`, `endUse 0` and `endUse 1` are all rejected (`cycle_by_endUse`).
- (D) Exit with re-anchoring: from `dl1`, the callee builds the cycle on the caller's leaves with a helper it holds itself, then exits (`ok`).
  - The exit releases the helper and re-attaches the two authorities to the caller's roots: `ex5.org 4 = some 1`, `ex5.org 6 = some 0`.
  - In the caller, both are then unexercisable and `¬ HasRight ex5 .observe 0/1` (`cycle_by_exit`).
- (E) Free: with `KT [] [] [] [4] [(4,4)]`, the helper is stored into owned storage leaf 4, then `free 4` (`ok`) closes the cycle (`cycle_by_free`, `Q3free.lean`).
- (F) EnterFrame: I found no witness. Passing the helper as a parameter is rejected by G1:
```lean
theorem enter_helper_rejected : EnterStep [4] [] eu5 .reject := .reject (by decide)
theorem enter_helper_reason : ¬ ParamOriginHidden (enterEff eu5 [4] []) 4 := by decide
```
- Why it matters: G2 guards only `store`, so it delays the F7 (a) and three-node cycles rather than preventing them. G3 as written does not catch them either (F1). Per the brief ("contre-exemples conservés"), these counterexamples should be kept.

**F3. Minor, wording.** Location: docstring of `progress_cycle_three_nodes` (about 10672). It says "C would be covered by 10 only", which uses "covered" in the effective sense. Under `CoversHolder`, node C (8) is also covered by `internal` 5 (held by place 0) and block 8 (held by place 4). So the rejected store would not be an orphan in the module's G3 sense. `Q4.lean`: `footprint tc8.P 8 = [8] ∧ tc8.Active 5 ∧ 8 ∈ tc8.afp 5 ∧ tc8.Active 8 ∧ 8 ∈ tc8.afp 8 ∧ …holders place 0 / place 4` by `decide`.

## Checked and found correct
- **`NoOrphan` against the G3 text:** the chain starts at an active authority held by a frame in `s.F` (any frame of the stack), ends at `x`, and every link is active and covers the holder of the next (`Linked`, `CoversHolder`).
  - `Nodup` is on authorities, not holders. That makes no difference: a chain with a repeated holder can always be shortened, because `CoversHolder a b` depends only on `b`'s holder, and the head is held by a frame while every later element is held by a place.
  - No footprint is empty in a well-formed state (`exists_mem_footprint`), so coverage is never vacuously true.
- **`dropLoops`:** the fuel `c.length + 1` is the list's length, which `dropLoops_nodup` needs; head, last element and links are all preserved. `chain_to_frame` goes by induction on `Usable`, and `rootLive_cover` uses `footprint_sub` and `ownerOf`.
- **`reachable_rootLive`:** covers all 20 constructors of `Reachable`, with no extra hypotheses. Transfer moves the root together with the place's owner, and exit keeps roots because they survive and have no origin.
- **Non-vacuity:** `DDSound` is satisfied (`KT_dd`), and NoOrphan is obtained on real reached states (`hu1`, `iu1`, `fh2`, `ex5`, `fr6`).
- **Axioms:** `#print axioms` on `reachable_no_orphan`, `reachable_rootLive`, `noOrphan_of_rootLive`, `reachable_access_invariant_ext`, both `held_unexercisable_*` and `dropLoops_nodup` gives `[propext, Quot.sound]`. The HEAD file has no `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide` or `axiom`.
- **Item 4 of the brief:** NoOrphan is a conjunct of `reachable_access_invariant_ext` (8278). Preservation is shown for every operation through `WF3 ∧ RootLive` (one `*_rootLive` lemma per operation, then `noOrphan_of_rootLive`). There is no standalone `*_preserves_noOrphan` per operation. `reachable_access_invariant_underDD` is unchanged; the arbiter's wording is met through the new `_ext` theorem.

I did not check whether NoOrphan alone (without `RootLive`) is preserved by each operation. I also did not try to prove NoOrphanEff false in general beyond the reached witnesses. The working tree changed during the review, so these results hold for 72337e7 only.
